content.text:
I made the chain tab see-through, so Code and Spec show under it when they join. The chat input tests pass (15 of 15), but I haven't run the app to look at it, so please check it on screen.

**The cause:** the chain is its own tab bar, and the UI library paints every tab bar with a solid background and a 1px bottom border. That solid box covered the joined Code and Spec, and its edges against the purple likely looked like left and right borders. The tab itself has no visible side borders when it isn't selected, and the chain never shows as selected.

**The fix** (`src/chat_input.rs:503`):
- **Background:** the chain's bar now has a transparent background.
- **Bottom border:** the chain is now clipped just above that border. Otherwise the border would draw a line across the bottom of the joined tab. When the chain sits between Code and Spec, the border along the bottom of the tab row still shows through.

**Two things to look at:**
- While Code and Spec are sliding together, their inner borders will now show through the chain until they meet. Once they meet, the existing seam cover hides that line.
- The chain's click area is 1px shorter at the bottom because of the clip.
